#!/bin/sh

set -a

DATABASE_URL=$(cat <<'EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
postgres://localhost/app
EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
)

NODE_ENV=$(cat <<'EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
production
EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
)

set +a

npx prisma migrate deploy


exec node server.js
